headline: President Issues New Threat to Obliterate Iran's Energy Infrastructure if Ceasefire Talks Fail
summary: This explicit threat against a major oil producer's critical infrastructure risks a severe global energy crisis and expansion of regional conflict, profoundly impacting international trade and geopolitical stability. Escalation would immediately disrupt oil and gas supplies, shipping routes, and global economic forecasts, sending shockwaves through commodity markets and broader supply chains.
